comment: Territory growth dials (docs/world-objects-expansion-design.md §10). A new tile unlocks when its authored requirements are met AND the pressure gate passes (>=pressureGate of current capacity actually planted) — so new land never arrives while the old land is empty. Beyond the authored list the formula takes over; sides cycle ne→sw→se→nw and step outward a ring every 4 tiles (roads stay connected edge-to-edge).
